relevance_note: Single-patient case report of SSADH deficiency with two ALDH5A1 variants: "Sequencing of ALDH5A1 revealed a heterozygous splice site variant c.610-612A>G (IVS3-2A>G) in intron 3".
method_note: Built by hand from a full reading of this short case report; a small Python script only assembled the JSON. One individual (label 'patient', rule 5). Variant 1 is printed as 'c.610-612A>G (IVS3-2A>G)', an unusual notation, recorded exactly as printed; no protein change printed. Inheritance: the paper says only 'Biparental inheritance was confirmed.' without saying which parent carries which variant, so both rows are 'inherited unspecified parent'. Zygosity recorded as 'heterozygous' as printed for each variant; the paper does not use 'compound heterozygous'. Pathogenicity 'considered pathogenic' is stated for 'Both mutations'. Temporal changes (not contradictions): exaggerated Moro reflex absent by 4 months, exaggerated startle absent at 7–8 months, deep tendon reflexes preserved at 1.5 months then hyporeflexia; these are in severity_or_detail, with no separate excluded rows. EEG: the paper describes the EEG (high amplitude delta activity with bursts of sharpened alpha/beta activity asleep) but never calls it abnormal or epileptiform, so no feature row and the EEG checklist item is not reported. The 'stiffening episodes' are never called seizures, so 'seizures or epilepsy' is not reported (vigabatrin use not used as evidence). Brain MRI 'was normal' is a whole investigation, so it is recorded as 'abnormal brain MRI' excluded and excludes no specific MRI checklist item. Inability to maintain head control at 4 months is recorded as a feature but not used to mark 'gross or fine motor deficits'. The sentence 'she continued to have severe diffuse though head lag had improved' appears to be missing a word; nothing was recorded from 'severe diffuse'. No contradictions found.
